name: US Monthly Electronics Shipments
citation: U.S. Census Bureau. "Manufacturers Shipments: Computers and Electronic Products (A34SVS)." FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/A34SVS. Accessed 15 July 2026.

description:
Monthly U.S. Census M3 value of shipments for Computers & Electronic Products, seasonally adjusted (millions USD), used as the free downloadable proxy for the WSTS/SIA global semiconductor-billings silicon cycle, with the matching M3 inventories covariate. Application: fab capacity/inventory-cycle planning (the glut-vs-shortage call). NOTE: the standalone Census semiconductor series (U34GVS) was discontinued in 2010, so the broader electronics aggregate is the maintained proxy; WSTS/SIA billings are the pure-play (paywalled) target.

Covariate glossary:
- computers and electronic products shipments: Census M3 total value of shipments, Computers & Electronic Products, millions of USD, seasonally adjusted (FRED A34SVS).
- computers and electronic products inventories: Census M3 total inventories, Computers & Electronic Products, millions of USD (FRED A34STI) - channel-inventory / bullwhip signal.
preprocessing: 1. Downloaded each monthly series from the FRED CSV endpoint (fredgraph.csv?id=<ID>).
2. Aligned target and covariates onto a common month-start (MS) time index.
3. Restricted to the common native span (first month where every covariate is observed through the last observed target month).
4. Forward-filled only sparse internal covariate gaps; no target imputation.
5. Dropped all calendar/timestep columns; kept a single shared ISO-8601 UTC timestamp index.
